paper_metadata.title: A high-temperature Ti-6.8Al-6.8Zr-2.3V-2.1Mo-0.7Nb alloy suitable for laser-additive manufacturing

evidence.quote: A high-temperature Ti-6.8Al-6.8Zr-2.3V-2.1Mo-0.7Nb alloy suitable for laser additive manufacturing is designed

A high-temperature Ti-6.8Al-6.8Zr-2.3V-2.1Mo-0.7Nb alloy is designed following the cluster formula α-{[Al–Ti12](AlTi2)}12 + β-{[Al–Ti12Zr2](AlV1.2Mo0.6Nb0.2)}5, similar to that of Ti–6Al–4V but with enhanced β stability via Zr, Mo, Nb, and V co-alloying.

Hence, the bulk samples are prepared using the optimized parameters of P = 2000 W, V = 10 mm/s, and F = 1.2 mm/s.
